title: Cloned constraint payoff
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment, let $M$ be a natural number, let an assignment give a value in the domain $D$ to each variable in $V\times\text{Fin}(M)$, and fix an outcome and clone labels for its query positions. The cloned constraint payoff is $1$ if the predicate selected by the outcome is satisfied by the assigned values at the corresponding original variables and clone labels, and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A clone label for each query position
